name: Romeo Beckham
bio: Romeo James Beckham (born September 1, 2002) is an English model, actor and former footballer. He is the second son of former footballer David Beckham and former Spice Girls member Victoria Beckham.

credits.title: Forty Love
credits.overview: Sacha Gallo, a tennis prodigy, has been training with his father to win a major trophy in Paris. But the arrival of a charismatic new rival challenges everything Sacha thought he understood about competition, ambition, and himself.

credits.title: Victoria Beckham: Coming to America
credits.overview: An insider's look at the life of former Spice Girl Victoria Beckham and her world famous footballer husband David Beckham as they move their family from England to Southern California.

credits.title: The 'Réal' Beckhams
credits.overview: This astonishing fly-on-the-wall documentary of one of the world`s most famous celebrity couple catches David signing to Real Madrid, Victoria launch her new singles and the family move to Spain. The video captures the glamour and glitz, and also the trials and tribulations of being famous. Documentary from 2003.
